text.en:
Item (16), paragraph g., Batangas, subsection three, title A, section one of Republic Act Numbered Twelve hundred, is hereby amended to read as follows:
"(16) Construction of Industrial Arts Building, Sabang, Lipa City ₱4,000.00 (16-a) Construction of academic building, Sabang, Lipa City 26,000.00"

This Act shall take effect upon it approval.
Approved: June 22, 1957.
